title: Essential Verb - {partir} (to leave)
description: Master departures through active recall and composition practice!
can_do: Express leaving and departing (I leave, you leave, they leave)
Combine with venir and aller for complete movement vocabulary

concepts.definition: Common verb for leaving a place or departing
concepts.example: Essential for talking about travel and movement away from places
Singular: {je}/{tu pars}, il part. Plural: {nous partons}, {vous partez}

concepts.definition: Combine partir with previous modules for infinite expressions
concepts.example: {je pars + ça}, {nous partons + être}, {ils partent + avoir}

items.situation: Say what you do

mistakes.feedback: Je takes '{pars}', not 'part'. Remember: je pars, il part
That's 'you leave', not 'I leave'. Focus on the pronoun!
